mentions.name: HatchAStory
mentions.description: This app generates fun, personalised bedtime stories in seconds. It has a backend and web version, and development is now focused on an Expo/React Native mobile app.
mentions.problem: As a busy dad, the author needed a fast way to generate fun, personalised bedtime stories.
mentions.audience: Busy parents looking for a quick way to create personalised bedtime stories
mentions.source_excerpt: Building HatchAStory for my own needs as a busy dad — to generate fun, personalised bedtime stories in seconds.
